environment.install: editable main package with educational,test extras

requested_change_checks: Two-stage baseline rejected; at-bb source conservation and all allowed feature/model combinations
Disabling cosine removes its source-delta gradient; single-stage loss is unaffected by cosine weight
evidential_weight exact log range 0.0001 to 0.1; lambda_sim exact stepped range 0.02 to 0.05 only for enabled two-stage models
Training scores use pm25_filled; observed pm25 scoring remains strict and excludes missing observations
Real MLP training study resumes from one to two trials with prior trial preserved
Real SQLite study resumes from 25 to 50 trials with cheap objective stub; previous values, parameters, timestamps, attributes and scaler preserved
Same target trial count does not rerun; lower target raises without modifying history
Failed later trial preserves completed scores and exports COMPLETE/FAIL history
Missing SQLite database alongside saved summaries raises without overwriting history

notebooks.execution_mode: fresh interpreter and in-process IPython kernel per notebook; inline Matplotlib backend
output_checks: All twelve notebooks executed every code cell without errors
All six HPT exports contain training metrics and the requested conditional search weights
All six usage notebooks saved train_predictions.csv, train_scores.csv, test_predictions.csv and test_scores.csv
Saved train/test metrics agree with recomputation from CSV predictions
All two-stage exported source contributions sum exactly to predicted totals after round-trip CSV parsing
All exported total variances equal aleatoric plus epistemic variances
All inline and saved plots decode and contain nonblank image data

limitations: Small schema-matched synthetic fixture only; these checks do not establish predictive performance on research data
Linux CPU runtime validation; native macOS, Windows and GPU execution not tested in this workspace
Notebook execution bypassed ZeroMQ transport because this host restricts sockets
The 25-to-50 trial test uses a cheap objective stub to isolate persistence; numerical resume is separately checked with actual one-to-two-trial training
Passing tests does not prove every function error-free or validate scientific conclusions

preservation.notebooks: Original cell counts, IDs, metadata and plotting cells preserved; only requested settings/scoring/import/prose/assertions changed.
